acceptance_criteria.criterion: All non-namespaced route blocks in `server.ts` have deprecation comments
Comments specify the replacement namespaced route and planned removal version
No functional change to route behavior — routes continue to work during the deprecation period

summary: Added @deprecated comments to all 21 non-namespaced route blocks in mcp-server/gui/server.ts. Each comment specifies the replacement namespaced /:repo/:slug route and states that the route will be removed in the next major version. No functional changes were made — all routes continue to work identically. Coverage: 13 routes in matchRoute() (plan, synthesis, health, run-metadata, GET project, work-packages, work-packages/overview, dialogues/:filename, work-packages/:wpId, dialogues list, chunks list, chunks/:filename/rendered, chunks/:filename), 2 run-log routes (runs list and runs/:filename), 4 mutation routes in matchRoute() (DELETE project, POST archive/unarchive/complete), plus 2 body-parsing special cases in handleRequest() (PATCH flat project rename, POST flat reset). TypeScript compiled cleanly (tsc --noEmit exit 0). All 2843 tests pass (93 test files, no regressions).

comments.note: No observations — the touched route blocks are well-structured and consistent. The deprecation comments follow the same format throughout the file.

summary: All 3 ACs verified. 21 @deprecated comments confirmed across all non-namespaced route blocks: 13 in matchRoute() (plan, synthesis, health, run-metadata, GET project, work-packages, work-packages/overview, dialogues/:filename, work-packages/:wpId, dialogues list, chunks list, chunks/:filename/rendered, chunks/:filename), 2 run-log routes (runs list, runs/:filename), 4 mutation routes (DELETE project, POST archive/unarchive/complete), 2 body-parsing special cases in handleRequest() (PATCH flat rename, POST flat reset). comments.note: Comment format is perfectly consistent across all 21 blocks: two-line pattern '// @deprecated — Use {METHOD} {namespaced_route} instead.' followed by '// This non-namespaced route is retained for backward compatibility and will be / // removed in the next major version.' No deviations found.

Edge case verified: the two body-parsing branches inside handleRequest() (PATCH flat project rename at patchSegs.length !== 2, and POST flat reset at postSegments.length === 4) both carry correct @deprecated comments, matching the pattern of the matchRoute() blocks.

summary: Reviewed all 21 @deprecated comment blocks in mcp-server/gui/server.ts. The change is a pure documentation-only addition — no functional logic was modified. All four review dimensions pass cleanly: (1) Maintainability: comments are uniformly formatted and correctly placed immediately before each non-namespaced route condition block; (2) Best Practices: the inline `// @deprecated` style is correctly used for routing blocks (JSDoc @deprecated is for function/class declarations, not inline if-else dispatch); (3) Performance: zero runtime impact — comments are stripped at compile/transpile time; (4) Future Context: the deprecation wording precisely names the replacement namespaced route and states removal timing ('next major version'), giving future developers clear migration targets. One Documentation-Forward item was identified: the route map summary comment (lines 1280–1310) lists deprecated flat routes without marking them deprecated — this will confuse future contributors scanning the summary. Tagged for the Documentation agent."
